name: The Last Empire
tagline: Nobility, thievery, and intrigue in a dying empire.

attributes.description: Raw strength, toughness, and physical capability.

skills.name: Ranged Weapons

skills.name: Dance

skills.name: Intimidation

skills.name: Magic Knowledge
skills.description: Understanding of magic and its workings.

skills.name: History
skills.description: The rise and rot of the Empire and its houses.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Magic, myth, and the things scholars whisper about.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Reading scenes, connecting clues, finding what's hidden.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Treating wounds, poisons, and fevers.

skills.name: Construction
skills.description: Building and repairing and knowing structures.

abilities.name: Bodymancy
abilities.description: Strengthen your body and resilience to perform supernatural physical feats.

abilities.name: Emomancy
abilities.description: Influence and read the emotions of others.

abilities.name: Ferromancy

abilities.name: Magnetomancy

abilities.description: Enhance your perception and sensory powers.

backgrounds.description: Raised on the streets, you scrounge and struggle for survival in a harsh world.

backgrounds.description: Born with untapped potential for magic, you were born into a life of drudgery until fate had other plans
